name: The Rich Man
overview: Scripture presents the rich man as a figure who enjoys earthly wealth and luxury, as seen in Luke 16:19 where he is clothed in fine garments and lives sumptuously. However, Proverbs 21:20 contrasts wisdom and folly in managing resources, warning against reckless spending. The teachings in Matthew 6:24 emphasize that one cannot serve both God and wealth, highlighting the spiritual danger of divided loyalties. Additionally, Matthew 19:16 shows that eternal life is sought through good deeds and devotion to God rather than material riches.
